name: Categorical Chords
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Explore spatial contacts or shared membership between categorical annotations with count-weighted ribbons and enrichment colors.

params.name: mode
params.label: Relationship
params.help: Selects whether to analyze spatial contacts between different cells or relationships between two annotations on the same cells.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping annotation
params.help:
Selects the categorical annotation used for the groups.
In annotation mode, this is the first of the two annotations.

params.name: other_field
params.label: Second annotation
params.help:
Selects the second annotation compared on the same cells.
Used only for Annotation relationships.

params.name: radius
params.label: Contact radius
params.help:
Sets the maximum distance between two cells for them to count as a spatial contact, in dataset coordinate units.
Used only for Spatial contacts.

params.name: min_count
params.label: Minimum ribbon support
params.help: Shows a ribbon only when the relationship contains at least this many observed cells or spatial pairs.

params.name: max_nodes
params.label: Maximum sectors
params.help: Limits how many groups appear around the chord diagram to the most abundant ones.

params.name: max_links
params.label: Maximum ribbons
params.help: Sets the maximum number of relationships shown, keeping those with the highest observed counts.

params.name: self_links
params.label: Include within-group contacts
params.help:
Includes spatial contacts between cells belonging to the same group.
Used only for Spatial contacts.
